segments.tha-ap239:1.3: Piyālaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā, gatamagge khipiṃ ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap239:4.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā piyālapupphiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.

lines: Sattamāpadāne piyālaṃ pupphitaṃ disvāti supupphitaṃ piyālarukkhaṃ disvā.
Gatamagge khipiṃ ahanti ahaṃ migaluddo nesādo hutvā piyālapupphaṃ ocinitvā buddhassa gatamagge khipiṃ pūjesinti attho.
